spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Analog values are rounded to 2 decimals; units are in the signal name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.torque__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 2 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.speed__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 3 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.power__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 4 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.temp_igbt__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 5 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.temp_power_stage__value, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Torque [Nm]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Speed [rpm]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Power [kW]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'IGBT temperature [°C]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'Power stage temp. [°C]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
ORDER BY s.n
